note: Zephyr-80 Mk2 nucleus residency (architecture 2.7.6). The system DAT is fixed after the boot except the entries `system_dat` marks remapped; every nucleus object links into the fixed region (system entries 1-2) or the cold region (entries 3-4), and nothing links into the copy windows. The cold objects are Mk1 cold-tier objects (config/residency.json), so a code path that must stay mapped while another page set occupies entries 3-4 is fixed on both boards; the fixed region also holds cold-tier objects the cold region has no room for. tools/mapcheck.py mk2 enforces the regions, the lists and the common-page budget.

system_dat.holds: the system page-0 image (SRAM 40h): the low entry stubs
system_dat.remapped: by the syscall gate to the caller's page 0 for each crossing, and per exec depth by the launch gate

system_dat.holds: nucleus fixed region (SRAM 42h), the ISR stack at 5F00h

system_dat.remapped: by kernel/memory/mk2/page_copy.asm per chunk (a caller's, an object's or a ROM page)

system_dat.holds: the common page (SRAM 7Fh), also working entry 15
